analysis: MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW: SPY remains in confirmed uptrend (+2% vs SMA50, positive slope), which supports holding existing longs and selectively adding high-conviction setups. However, the historical record (10% win rate, profit factor 0.03x, Sortino -12.69) demands extreme discipline — each new trade must clear a high bar. EXISTING POSITIONS: AMP (-2.71%), BR (-2.35%), MCO (-1.09%) are all within normal noise, thesis intact; no stop-level violations observed. NVDA (+4.14%) is the only winner and looks constructive with strong EPS revisions (+22.6%) and approaching 52w high — hold. I will not add to NVDA here at 89% range position (+6% vs SMA50); that is extended late-cycle territory. NEW SETUP — TEL: TE Connectivity is the standout candidate. It sits at only 30% of its 52w range (lower half, Stage 1→2 basing territory), has a forward P/E of 16.26 and PEG of 0.88 (genuine value), solid FCF of $2.3B, ROE 23.3%, and 13.8% revenue growth. Price is just +1.7% above SMA50 (not extended) and -1.8% below SMA200 — an imminent SMA200 breakout would confirm Stage 2. This is the only candidate offering both fundamental quality at fair price AND a non-extended technical entry. All other top-ranked candidates (PSX 92% range, ZBRA 82%, APA 86%, ANET 95%) are too extended. HOOD and PLTR are speculative and high-volatility. Given 4 existing positions already (at the target concentration level), I am recommending only 1 new buy — TEL — sized conservatively within the 25% cap and 1-2% portfolio heat rule. Remaining cash post-trade remains substantial, providing optionality.
